question: Does the physical fascicle-4 manuscript of Zhou Shuxue's Shendao Dabian Lizong Tongyi v11 directly preserve a Zhao Yuandu-attributed hundred-ke / half-Zi prose layer and an explicit regional daylength-calibration argument close enough to clarify Sanming 1578 textual ancestry, without falsely promoting this manuscript to the exact 59/41 table parent?

physical_source.title: 《神道大編曆宗通議》十八卷 冊四 / 卷十一
physical_source.author: 明 周述學撰
physical_source.provider: 香港大學馮平山圖書館善本書影像庫; public surrogate via Wikimedia Commons

readings: 神道大編曆宗通議卷十一
卷首直接見趙緣督名號
革象論
旁有小字凡十八
page115.philology_note: Public transcription often linearizes this as 趙緣督十八篇論 / 革象論. The reviewed physical layout is not normalized into that sequence; the Zhao Yuandu attribution, 革象論 title and small 凡十八 note are preserved as separate layout facts.

readings: 晝夜十二時均分百刻
一時有八大刻二小刻
大刻總九十六小刻總二十四
小刻六準大刻一故此為百刻也
上半時之大四刻……始曰初初……最後小刻為初四
下半時之大刻亦四……
page145.heading_note: The reviewed p145 has a blank/omitted heading locus before this paragraph. The section is conventionally transcribed as 論晝夜百刻, but that heading is not promoted as a direct p145 glyph claim.

readings: 若子時則上半時在夜半前屬昨日
下半時在夜半後屬今日
古曆每時以二小刻為始乃各繼以四大刻
然不若今曆之便於算策也
世謂子午卯酉各九刻餘皆八刻者非是
愚謂今曆雖便於算策而亦失其名實
論地域遠近
陽城仰觀北極出地三十六度
至錢唐則出入之度三十一
又南至交廣則出入之度二十而已
舊曆晝永極於六十刻晝短極於四十刻
今授時曆以驗於燕地稍偏北故其永...
至六十二刻短至三十八刻
蓋偏南則長短較少偏北則所較漸多
夏日出寅入戌其地近北
冬日出辰入申其地近南

direct_physical_collation.method: Direct visual collation of 300-dpi source-bound physical renders; OCR/text layer not used as glyph authority.

received_gexiang_physical_readings: 晝夜十二時均分為百刻
子時之上一半在夜半前屬昨日
下一半在夜半後屬今日
shendao_significance: The physical v11 explicitly attributes the essay group to 趙緣督 and opens with 革象論, materially linking the Ming compilation to the Zhao/Gexiang textual tradition.
The hundred-ke / half-Zi mechanics are retained, while wording is rephrased in a form closer to Sanming at the decisive locus: 若子時則上半時... / 下半時....

sanming_physical_core: 大晝夜十二時均分百刻一時有八大刻二小刻
若子時則上半時在夜半前為昨日
下半時在夜半後屬今日
shendao_core: 晝夜十二時均分百刻一時有八大刻二小刻
若子時則上半時在夜半前屬昨日
下半時在夜半後屬今日
comparison_to_sanming_1578.key_recension_variant: Shendao has 屬昨日 / 屬今日; exact 1578 Sanming has 為昨日 / 屬今日.

regional_calibration_adjudication.shendao_explicit_principle: 偏南則長短較少；偏北則所較漸多
regional_calibration_adjudication.significance: A Ming Zhao-line calendrical discourse directly preserves geographic calibration as an explicit explanatory principle, so locality adaptation is not a modern reconstruction.

chronology_firewalls.safe_claim: This witness closes a Ming received/middleware form of the Zhao Yuandu timekeeping prose and regional-calibration theory. It does not close the current manuscript date before 1578 or direct stemmatic direction into Sanming.

edges_supported: Shendao physical copy ATTESTS Zhao-attributed hundred-ke/half-Zi passage
Gexiang, Shendao and Sanming passages ATTEST the same hundred-ke/half-Zi rule family
Gexiang received passage remains a textual ancestry candidate for both Shendao and Sanming
edges_rejected_or_unproved: Direct Shendao manuscript -> Sanming 1578 copying remains unproved.
Shendao regional 60/40 or Yandu 62/38 passage is not the unchanged numeric parent of Sanming 59/41.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Find a physically pre-1578 witness of the Zhao/Gexiang-derived Ming prose recension closer to Sanming.
Find a pre-1578 Chinese carrier combining the Nanjing 59-ke locality layer with the exact Sanming/Yueling change-day fingerprint.
Identify the exact C-II-N post-computation integer selection/threshold rule.
